# multitask.lazy.execute_lazy { #spotforecast2_safe.multitask.lazy.execute_lazy }

```python
multitask.lazy.execute_lazy(
    task,
    show=False,
    use_tuned_params=True,
    max_age_days=None,
)
```

Execute lazy fitting for all targets on ``task``.

Thin wrapper around ``BaseTask._run_strategy`` using ``LazyStrategy``.
When ``use_tuned_params`` is ``True`` (the default), previously saved
tuning results are loaded from cache and applied to the forecaster.
If no cached results are found the forecaster uses default parameters.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                                     | Description                                                                                    | Default    |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| task             | [BaseTask](`spotforecast2_safe.multitask.base.BaseTask`) | A ``BaseTask`` (or subclass) instance with prepared data.                                      | _required_ |
| show             | [bool](`bool`)                                           | If ``True``, invoke the visualisation hooks.                                                   | `False`    |
| use_tuned_params | [bool](`bool`)                                           | If ``True``, attempt to load cached tuning results (best parameters and lags) for each target. | `True`     |
| max_age_days     | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[float](`float`)\]        | Maximum age in days for cached tuning results. ``None`` accepts any age.                       | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                                                             |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Aggregated prediction package (weighted combination of all targets).    |
|        | [Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Per-target packages are stored on ``task.results["lazy"]``.             |
|        | [Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | When ``task.config.auto_save_models`` is ``True`` (the default), fitted |
|        | [Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | models are saved to disk so ``PredictTask`` can load them directly.     |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```{python}
import tempfile
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from spotforecast2_safe.multitask.lazy import LazyTask, execute_lazy
from spotforecast2_safe.configurator.config_multi import ConfigMulti

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
idx = pd.date_range("2023-01-01", periods=24 * 14, freq="h", tz="UTC")
df = pd.DataFrame({"load": rng.normal(100, 10, len(idx))}, index=idx)
df.index.name = "DateTime"

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    cfg = ConfigMulti(
        predict_size=6,
        use_exogenous_features=False,
        use_outlier_detection=False,
        cache_home=tmp,
        auto_save_models=False,
        number_folds=2,
    )
    task = LazyTask(cfg, dataframe=df)
    task.prepare_data()
    result = execute_lazy(task, show=False, use_tuned_params=False)
    print(f"Keys: {list(result.keys())[:4]}")
    print(f"Forecast horizon: {len(result['future_pred'])} steps")
    assert len(result["future_pred"]) == 6
```
